events.factual_description: Blue Note Japan presents JAZZ-FUSION SUMMIT 2026 on Sunday, November 1, 2026 at Kanadevia Hall in Bunkyo, Tokyo, with doors at 2:00 PM and a 3:00 PM start. The fourth edition brings together five Japanese instrumental projects: the Blue Note Tokyo All-Star Jazz Orchestra directed by Eric Miyashiro, T-SQUARE, DIMENSION in its 35th-anniversary year, Masato Honda Band, and a cross-genre trio led by flamenco guitarist Jin Oki with Yosuke Onuma and Takamitsu Ishizuka. General ticket sales are active through authorized sellers linked by Blue Note Japan.

en.why_it_matters: This is not a generic fusion package. In one afternoon it compresses several generations of Japan's instrumental-fusion language: T-SQUARE's still-evolving lineage, DIMENSION in its 35th-anniversary year, Masato Honda's saxophone-centered virtuosity, Eric Miyashiro's all-star big-band engine, and a flamenco/jazz guitar bridge through Jin Oki and Yosuke Onuma. The one-day convergence and concentration of identifiable instrumental voices make the event more important than any single routine tour stop by these groups.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect the day and build a Tokyo outing around it: the density of Japanese fusion lineages and instrumental personalities in one bill is unusually high. It strengthens a Japan music trip substantially, though it does not by itself require a transpacific trip.
en.listen_before: T-SQUARE — TURN THE PAGE!; DIMENSION — 34; Masato Honda — MASATO HONDA (with VOICE OF ELEMENTS)

es.why_it_matters: Esto no es un paquete genérico de fusión. En una sola tarde concentra varias generaciones del lenguaje instrumental japonés: la tradición todavía activa de T-SQUARE, DIMENSION en su 35 aniversario, el virtuosismo centrado en el saxofón de Masato Honda, la maquinaria de big band all-star de Eric Miyashiro y un puente flamenco/jazz de guitarra con Jin Oki y Yosuke Onuma. La convergencia de un solo día y la concentración de voces instrumentales reconocibles hacen que el evento pese más que una parada rutinaria de cualquiera de estos grupos por separado.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Sí vale proteger el día y construir una salida de Tokio alrededor del festival: la densidad de linajes de jazz-fusión japonés y personalidades instrumentales en un solo cartel es excepcionalmente alta. Fortalece mucho un viaje musical a Japón, aunque por sí solo no exige cruzar el Pacífico.
